title: anthyllis vulgaris
intro: Anthyllis vulgaris, commonly known as Kidney Vetch or Common Kidney Vetch, is a perennial flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating kidney and bladder issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis vulgaris include its ability to act as a diuretic and astringent, which can help to reduce inflammation and promote healing in the urinary tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
